A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the current study found that attachment anxiety and avoidant attachment were related to more negative perceptions of team cohesiveness and organizational fairness, which in turn, contributed towards higher job burnout.
attachment insecurity is related to job burnout through the mediation of lower team cohesion and organizational unfairness.
attachment insecurities were linked to job burnout through negative perceptions of team members and organizational fairness.

attachment theory can be used to explain the mechanisms through which employees’ attachment orientations influence their work-related attitudes, and that the findings of the current study may be used to inform interventions aimed at reducing burnout among employees.
